messages.summary:
## Objective
- Improve the existing real-time strategy game so players explore a larger, initially obscured battlefield to find the enemy.
- Refine building, vehicle, and soldier models, and fix tank movement during combat.

## Requirements
- Make the map much larger and require exploration to locate enemies.
- Keep unexplored areas blacked out until explored.
- Make buildings look like buildings, tanks like tanks, and soldiers more detailed and realistic.
- Allow tanks to move while engaged in battle.
- Build or modify the playable game without asking clarifying questions; briefly note assumptions when finished.

## Decisions
- No new decisions made.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected `game.js`, `renderer3d.js`, `index.html`, `styles.css`, and `README.md` to understand the existing game.

### Active
- All requested gameplay and visual changes remain to be implemented.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Expand the battlefield and tune the camera, enemy placement, and movement boundaries for exploration.
2. Verify and improve fog-of-war behavior so unexplored areas stay obscured and enemies are only revealed when explored.
3. Investigate combat movement and ensure player-issued movement orders continue while units are fighting.
4. Refine and verify the existing 3D models for buildings, vehicles, and soldiers.
5. Run the game and inspect a current screenshot; report assumptions and verification results.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Game setup, map input, unit movement and combat, enemy spawning, and camera controls.
- `renderer3d.js`: Battlefield rendering, fog of war, and 3D models for structures and units.
- `index.html`: Game interface and controls.
- `styles.css`: Layout and presentation.

## Important Context
- No files were modified; no changes have been committed.
- `renderer3d.js` already includes fog-of-war discovery and detailed 3D models, but the battlefield uses `WORLD = 160`, and fog is reset when a game is set up.
- In `game.js`, movement is handled in the unit update loop independently of firing; inspect combat target/order handling to identify why tanks fail to move during battle.

## Objective
- Expand the RTS battlefield so players must explore to find the enemy, with unexplored areas obscured.
- Improve building, vehicle, and soldier models, and ensure tanks can move while fighting.

## Requirements
- Expand the battlefield and adjust camera and movement boundaries.
- Keep unexplored areas blacked out and hide enemy entities until discovered.
- Make buildings, tanks, and soldiers more detailed and recognizable.
- Allow tanks to move while engaged in battle.
- Make changes directly without clarifying questions; briefly note assumptions when finished.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected `game.js` map, camera, movement, combat orders, enemy spawning, and fog-related rendering inputs.
- Inspected `renderer3d.js` battlefield sizing, fog of war, camera setup, and existing building and unit models.

### Active
- Expand the battlefield and tune camera, exploration, enemy placement, and movement boundaries.
- Refine building, vehicle, and soldier models.
- Verify that player-issued tank movement continues during combat.
- Run the game, inspect a screenshot, and report assumptions and verification results.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Implement battlefield expansion and tune camera, exploration, enemy placement, and movement boundaries.
2. Refine the models while preserving the existing Three.js rendering approach.
3. Verify tank movement during combat and that fog still conceals unexplored terrain and enemies.
4. Run the game, inspect a screenshot, and summarize assumptions and verification.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Game setup, map input, unit movement and combat, enemy spawning, and camera controls.
- `renderer3d.js`: Battlefield rendering, fog of war, and 3D building and unit models.

## Important Context
- No code changes have been made; `git status --short` showed no changes.
- `renderer3d.js` uses `WORLD = 160`; camera zoom is clamped from `0.8` to `1.8`, and `resetFog()` clears discovery.

- `game.js` uses normalized `0–1` coordinates; the initial blue base is near `(.13,.53)` and enemy HQ near `(.88,.45)`.
- Unit movement updates independently of firing, so combat does not inherently stop movement; investigate order and target handling for the tank issue.
